name: Citadines Connect Cecil Georgetown Penang
detail: A great little hotel with a strategic location, although it’s slightly on the outskirts of Georgetown. The rooms and overall space are compact, but everything is thoughtfully designed, modern, and well-equipped with complete facilities. Perfect for travelers who appreciate comfort, convenience, and modern amenities without needing a huge hotel room. Definitely a great stay in Penang!

name: Jazz Hotel Penang
detail: This was my first time booking at this hotel and my experience was very satisfying. The hotel staff were very friendly and provided excellent service to all guests, even those who were not VIPs. The room was comfortable, clean, and spacious. Although my room did not have an iron, I just had to call the hotel number to request one, and they sent an iron to my room right away. It was very convenient. For Muslim guests, there is a suitable space for prayers and a qibla direction marker on the ceiling. Parking inside the building is also easy and very convenient. The only slight improvement that could be made is regarding the Wi-Fi. Perhaps due to many guests using the Wi-Fi at the same time, the speed was somewhat slow. I hope the hotel can further enhance the quality and speed of the Wi-Fi in the future. I hope the hotel can continue to maintain the cleanliness of the rooms and the quality of service as it is now. Highly recommended and I will definitely come again!

name: Collection O Batu Ferringhi Beach formerly ESQ Ferringhi
detail: Cozy beds, spacious room, and awesome staff. We laughed through every photo attempt!

name: lyf Georgetown Penang
detail: The accommodation is clean and environmentally friendly, with comfortable beds. There are shared services including drinking water, ice, a microwave, as well as washing and drying machines. The decoration is appealing, and the location is excellent for enjoyable walks. I am very impressed.

name: Hotel Penaga
detail: Penang self-service hotel 🏨 share [smirk R] A friend recommended it to me 😄 it's really great The reception and staff are quite nice [laugh out loud R] No deposit required, breakfast included, there’s a drinking water dispenser As a water buffalo 🐃 this is very important The room is super spacious, has a bathtub and is very clean The key point is that it has a strong Nanyang style, the decor is exquisite You can even take direct photos [smirk R] Very exquisite, also has a bathtub 🛀 There’s a sofa 🛋️ so the child can sleep separately without disturbance Great geographical location, just a short walk to the pedestrian street But it’s also very quiet at night 🤫 The air conditioning is powerful! There’s also a ceiling fan There’s a small fridge, it's a bit old but when it starts it sounds like a bomber plane [smirk R] It’s fine for storing some unfinished sweet soup Only a five to ten minute walk to mural street, Peranakan Museum, and Shantou Street night market Markets, police station, haha Wanxiang pastry shop and Beryl’s chocolate are also nearby! In summary, it’s really nice.

name: G Hotel Gurney
detail: After comparing various options for accommodation, I decided on this one because it seemed cost-effective and, more importantly, the gym appeared to be well-equipped. It turned out to be the right choice. Although I arrived quite a bit earlier than the check-in time, I was able to check in a little early since a room happened to be available. Thanks to that, I was able to enjoy my first day of sightseeing without wasting any time. First of all, I was amazed at how beautiful the building and the interior of the hall were, and I was impressed by the staff's attentiveness. The gym was even better than I expected and was extremely helpful. I think it might be a bit outside the city center, but since Grab rides are inexpensive, it really wasn't an issue at all. I believe I will definitely return to this place, and honestly, I'm even considering staying here again next time.

name: Spices Hotel
detail: A solid choice when visiting Penang! Clean and comfortable rooms, friendly staff, and a convenient location close to sightseeing and local food. It can be a little noisy during church services nearby, but overall, it was a great stay.

name: The Frame Guesthouse
detail: I had a really pleasant stay at Frame Guesthouse. The location is great, making it easy to explore the surrounding area and access many restaurants, cafes, and attractions. The room was clean and comfortable, and the overall atmosphere of the guesthouse was cozy and welcoming. The staff were also friendly and helpful throughout my stay.

name: SAVV Hotel
detail: The location is good. It's facing the main road on Penang Road, which means the sidewalk is poor and difficult to walk, but it's easy to call a Grab, and it's close to Armenian Street and Chulia Street, making it convenient for sightseeing. Chew Jetty is just across the street, so you can drop by easily. It's also great that myNEWS (convenience store) is very close, and it's an option to take out food from the food court. I was attracted to book it because the cabin's photos showed a full ocean view, but the cabin is on the second floor (Japanese style), so what you actually get is the lower half being a gas station across the road and the ocean being the upper half. I could see boats coming and going, which personally satisfied me. The hallway on my reserved floor had a red carpet, giving it a luxurious feel. Overall, the design is beautiful. Regarding cleanliness, I was not worried about bugs, and the pillows were not firm. I was a bit concerned about the lack of exhaust fans in the bathroom, but it seemed to be the same everywhere, so it doesn't seem to be a hotel-specific issue. Above all, the service from the staff was excellent, and since I don't speak English well, they patiently explained things even when I asked them to repeat. There are also a few staff members who can speak a little Japanese. The security staff is cheerful as well. Arriving early in the morning in Penang and being able to leave my luggage right away and head out for sightseeing on foot was great. Overall, I felt it was a good hotel that was free from any cheapness, yet still had a sense of warmth.

name: Grand Swiss Hotel
detail: This hotel offers excellent value for money, with a great location and complete surrounding facilities. The cleanliness of the rooms is satisfactory, and the spacious rooms provide comfort, with very charming views. The staff service is warm and attentive, making guests feel cozy. All necessary facilities and services are available, and the overall experience is outstanding, highly recommended for those looking to relax.
